system_thesis_interpretation: This is a deliberately game-specific engineering-ceiling canary, not a test of the frozen Paper-1 headline. It can test whether a frozen resolver, given an explicit solution ontology, proof-sequence scaffold, and an exact-endpoint/causal-join agenda, can complete a pre-registered end-to-end memory-and-reader pipeline without an exact cognitive truth verifier. It cannot establish autonomous abstraction, relevance discovery, durable parametric memory, generalization, action improvement, or a Paper-1-level benefit over raw context, retrieval, or other memory systems. The documents mostly make that boundary explicit; the title and repeated Paper-1 framing must not be allowed to erase it.
graph_delta_interpretation: The successor closes previously ambiguous governance edges: a single ASCII-sorted registry gives 142 exact producer-to-consumer tuples over 40 v1f files, with derived views nonnormative; terminal review failure has a separate direct HUMAN_TERMINAL base case; and P1CB10 is temporally split into pre-review mechanism evidence and post-review transition evidence. The experimental graph remains public episodes -> witnessed rows -> prompted DREAM -> same-model SELF_CHECK -> supported rows -> endpoint-cued return manipulation -> constrained text readers -> conditional per-life LoRAs -> rostered recognition. That graph has strong auditability, but its successful path still depends on the intervention-defined solution ontology and a single constructed twin pair.
loop_delta_interpretation: The measured contrast is only the post-prefix return treatment: M0 has zero return slots, OWN receives a THINK0 request for the exact later source/target endpoints, and DIST receives a public matched control. The common 84-slot recurrence, fixed prompt/schedule, public outcome stream, and later proof scaffold are not independently ablated. The prospective path removal and sham retention conditions make a successful text result a stronger within-pair structural-use demonstration than an outcome-only success, but they do not identify whether recurrence, DREAM, SELF_CHECK, the endpoint cue, the ontology prompt, or the final proof scaffold is the causal source of behavior. The LoRA portion is correctly downstream and conditional, with all 48 controller opportunities registered before fitting and withheld until two separate gates pass.
claim_delta_interpretation: The repaired claim boundary is substantially honest: THINK0 is disclosed as final-question/animal/answer withheld and exact-endpoint-cued; review records are SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED; and LoRA fidelity is called immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition. A green run may support only a one-pair, game-ontology- and proof-scaffolded integration observation with registered OWN/DIST/path/sham/twin behavior and in-sample rostered recognition. It has no comparative baseline, replication, uncertainty estimate, population inference, or held-out LoRA test, so it has no standalone paper value beyond implementation de-risking. A failure is likewise multiply determined and cannot localize an organ or negate the broader architecture.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The repair correctly separates FINAL_GOAL_PUBLIC_QUESTION from DONOR_BACKEND_IDENTITY and keeps final-goal coordinates host-only before reveal; P1CB02 also tests goal-coordinate inertness, cue substitution, and donor-taint rejection. This rules out the registered channels, not all semantic task leakage: the public probe exposes the exact final endpoints and explicitly asks for their causal join, while the frozen prompts disclose the intended relation/proof ontology. That is disclosed agenda and solution scaffolding rather than an undisclosed answer leak, but it materially narrows construct validity. Host pre-resolution plus an answer-bearing candidate roster is also an intentional recognition scaffold, not model-visible thinker leakage, and the contract labels it as such.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All nine v1e consensus repairs are resolved at the specification-and-test-design level, not yet empirically verified: (1) P1CB01 checks one exact registry, no wildcards/duplicates, and 40-file inventory closure; (2) P1CB01/P1CB09/P1CB10 exercise the direct nonrecursive fail-stop; (3) P1CB10 rejects future-digest and retroactive-transition evidence; (4) P1CB01/P1CB08/P1CB09 require the prospective 48-entry LoRA lifecycle and fidelity-failure rows; (5) P1CB02 discloses endpoint equality while testing withheld fields; (6) P1CB01/P1CB02/P1CB04 require atomic final-goal and donor cells; (7) P1CB01/P1CB10 demote review records and require an external witness release; (8) P1CB08/P1CB10 reject preservation/generalization wording; and (9) P1CB01/P1CB09 require a worst-case compute disclosure and a human engineering-value gate. These are useful protocol-falsification tests, but none supplies a model baseline, replications, confidence interval, or an out-of-sample capability measurement.
assumptions: The v1f context hashes were verified before this interpretation; implementation artifacts and any claimed P1CB receipts do not yet exist.
The proposal will retain its explicit engineering-canary-only claim firewall through terminal reporting and any human communication.
An external operator can actually witness releases and stop execution; the persisted role/freshness fields alone carry no evidentiary weight.
The public projection and candidate roster implementations will be independently tested against their contracts before any held-out dispatch.

ambiguities.question: What concrete human procedure records an operator witness release and makes failure to witness detectable, given that the schemas intentionally do not authenticate identity or freshness?
ambiguities.impact: This is not a scientific independence proof. Without a specified operating procedure it is a governance execution risk, although the direct fail-stop prevents a schema-only record from granting authority.

ambiguities.question: What, if anything, is the estimand of the conjunction over one selected seed-5 twin pair beyond successful completion of that fixed fixture?
ambiguities.impact: No sampling unit, replication plan, effect size, or uncertainty rule is defined; results must remain descriptive fixture outcomes.

ambiguities.question: How would a green or failed run distinguish the contribution of same-model SELF_CHECK from the prompted DREAM policy, endpoint cue, proof scaffold, or reader intervention?
ambiguities.impact: The design can document fallible model-supported rows but cannot support a self-check precision, recall, or mechanism-improvement claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: BLOCKER for any Paper-1/headline or autonomous-construction interpretation: v1f's exact-endpoint cue, explicit causal-join request, game-specific DREAM ontology, and proof-sequence-scaffolded THINK1 make a success compatible with scaffold following rather than autonomous constructive experiential memory.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The frozen goalposts forbid solution guidance in headline conditions and require held-out compositional behavior beyond raw context and retrieval. v1f openly supplies the relevance agenda and solution ontology, then evaluates one aligned pair; its own claim firewall correctly calls this coached relevance construction.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Ratify only as an engineering integration canary and retain the terminal prohibition on Paper-1, autonomous-discovery, generic-construction, and action-improvement claims. A Paper-1 experiment requires a separately ratified proposal with process-only prompts and the frozen baseline/generalization requirements.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: MATERIAL CONCERN, not a blocker to a narrowly labeled canary: one aligned seed-5 twin pair, conjunctive pass criteria, and 44/48 in-sample rostered recognition provide neither a fair baseline comparison nor replication, uncertainty, or population evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: M0/DIST/path/sham/twin are valuable within-fixture interventions, but they are not comparisons to raw history, RAG, a graph system, no-self-check, or alternative consolidation. The 48 LoRA fidelity cases are repeatedly trained selected cues with host pre-resolution and answer-bearing rosters. The v1e compute-value repair properly reclassifies the spend as engineering de-risking, not paper value.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Do not broaden v1f. Report every outcome as a descriptive integration fixture and require a separate ratified benchmark/replication design before making comparative, population, reliability, or Paper-1 claims.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: MATERIAL CONCERN: the P1CB10 identifier and role label use the word independent although the artifacts explicitly cannot prove independent review.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The v1e repair is substantively honored because the contract repeatedly says SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED and requires a human witness. Nevertheless, a label can be mistaken for evidence when excerpts are separated from the disclaimer.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the schema for compatibility but render review results as operator-witnessed self-declared workflow procedure, never as independently authenticated scientific review; require that disclosure in every packet summary and terminal artifact.

open_questions: Whether to ratify this strictly as an engineering integration canary despite its compute envelope and zero paper-level evidentiary value.
Whether the external witness procedure is sufficient for the requested governance purpose, acknowledging that it cannot establish authenticated identity or fresh-context independence.

Whether a later, separately ratified Paper-1 benchmark will add fair baselines, held-out/generalization measures, multiple seeds and skins, prompt-ablation boundaries, and replication before any scientific or publication claim.
